description: Check whether an accounting destination is connected and read-only setup state for the owner. Returns the selected organization/company/business, stored connection state, rollout state, and the single setup link for connecting or reconnecting the destination. When an existing ExpenseBot report is available, pass reportId so the link opens that exact report's provider setup control instead of the general Reports setup. This is read-only and never posts accounting data. Agent-driven posting is currently available only for Zoho Books (zoho_books); QuickBooks Online (quickbooks), Xero (xero), Wave (wave), and FreeAgent (freeagent, beta) are accepted here for connection/setup status only and report writesAuthorized=false until their canonical planning path is shared.

provider.description: Accounting destination provider. QuickBooks Online, Xero, Wave, FreeAgent (beta), or Zoho Books.

reportId.description: Optional existing ExpenseBot report ID. When supplied, setupUrl opens this exact report and highlights the selected accounting provider's setup control.

name: get_accounting_integration_status
